verses.text: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless the LORD, all servants of the LORD, Who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
verses.textZh: （上行之詩。）耶和華的僕人夜間站在耶和華殿中的，你們當稱頌耶和華！

verses.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary And bless the LORD.
verses.textZh: 你們當向聖所舉手，稱頌耶和華！

verses.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, He who made heaven and earth.
verses.textZh: 願造天地的耶和華，從錫安賜福給你們！
